import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
import { join } from 'node:path';
const systemCi = true;
test('acceptance: x', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, () => {});
const booted = existsSync(join('/run', 'systemd', 'system'));
test('acceptance: y (needs a booted systemd)', { skip: !booted && 'needs a booted systemd' }, () => { throw new Error('never runs anywhere'); });
